Give a single-use coupon back when its order is cancelled

place() records a single-use coupon's use under the order id, but cancel()
gave it back under the customer's name, so the match never succeeded and a
corrected order was refused as "already used". Give it back under the order
id, and cover the cancel-and-reuse case in the coupon tests.
